title: Schema for FluSight Network archive model metadata

team_name.description: Team name as given in the source repository

model_name.description: Model name as given in the source repository

model_contributors.description: Team members listed in the source metadata.txt

real_time_seasons.description: Seasons with forecasts made in real time (first committed no more than 3 days after the FluSight due date). A real-time season can still contain a few rounds that are not real-time; the exact flag per round is is_real_time in auxiliary-data/file-provenance.csv.

fsn_ensemble_component_seasons.description: Operational seasons in which this model was a component of the FluSight Network ensemble (listed in FSN's weights for that season's ensemble build). Component models only.

version_of.description: For models retrained between seasons: the source model this ID is one version of. Each version holds that model's backcasts and its real-time forecasts.

version_note.description: What distinguishes this version (retraining commit, seasons, FSN ensemble use).

paired_model_id.description: Ensembles only: the repaired copy of this ensemble build (FSNetwork-<ABBR>_<YYYY_YY>_repaired), or for a repaired copy the original.

source_dirs.description: Source directories (FluSightNetwork/cdc-flusight-ensemble unless prefixed with another repository).

seasons.description: Seasons with at least one forecast.

this_model_is_an_ensemble.description: From the source metadata.txt, self-reported by each team. FSN's guidelines (guidelines.md) define it only as "whether or not the model itself is a type of ensemble model" (template: this_model_is_an_ensemble: TRUE/FALSE).

methods.description: Methods text from the source metadata.txt

data_inputs.description: Data sources from the source metadata.txt

designated_model.description: Not used in this archive; always false.
